name: MXM P0 successor catalogue integration CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [mxm-p0-integrated-cache-successor-20261020]
  pull_request:
    branches: [mxm-o04-successor-code-integrated-p0-r2, mxm-p0-integrated-cache-successor-20261020]
permissions: {contents: read}
jobs:
  shared-catalogue-regression:
    if: github.repository == 'mariancradulescu/mxm-quant-greenfield'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: aa41ee31268bcf773f5f9299ac611d4bae7b88ff
          path: .selector-baseline
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: 9cc74472858ebcb3a80a3a7f12ad67f348304d13
          path: .chronology-baseline
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: |
          python3 -m pip install --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes -r research_core_v4/remediation_p0_p4_20261015/requirements.lock
      - name: Reproduce two selector defects on immutable pre-repair source
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import ast,hashlib,importlib.util,pathlib,subprocess,sys,unittest
          root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
          baseline=root/'.selector-baseline'
          assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=baseline,text=True).strip()=='aa41ee31268bcf773f5f9299ac611d4bae7b88ff'
          source=(baseline/'research_core_v4/laboratory/integrated.py').read_text()
          worker=next(n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='execute')
          nodes=[n.value for n in ast.walk(worker) if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and len(n.targets)==1 and isinstance(n.targets[0],ast.Name) and n.targets[0].id=='m' and isinstance(n.value,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.value.func,ast.Name) and n.value.func.id=='next']
          assert len(nodes)==1
          code=compile(ast.Expression(nodes[0]),str(baseline/'research_core_v4/laboratory/integrated.py'),'eval')
          sys.path.insert(0,str(baseline))
          from research_core_v4.laboratory import execution
          assert pathlib.Path(execution.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(baseline.resolve())
          def legacy(private,admission,book):
              return eval(code,{'p':private,'a':admission,'__builtins__':{'next':next}})
          execution.next_admitted_programme=legacy
          name='research_core_v4.laboratory.test_integrated_programme_selection'
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,root/'research_core_v4/laboratory/test_integrated_programme_selection.py')
          module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[name]=module;spec.loader.exec_module(module)
          case=module.IntegratedProgrammeSelectionTests
          suite=unittest.TestSuite(case(n) for n in ('test_prospective_priorities_produce_actual_A_B_resume_A','test_ambiguous_pending_programme_is_never_scheduled_around'))
          result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          assert result.testsRun==2 and len(result.failures)==2 and not result.errors
          print('MXM_NATIVE_SELECTOR_BEFORE: two expected semantic failures on immutable baseline aa41ee31268bcf773f5f9299ac611d4bae7b88ff; expression SHA256='+hashlib.sha256(ast.dump(nodes[0]).encode()).hexdigest())
          PY
      - name: Reproduce chronological defects on immutable recovery source
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import importlib.util,pathlib,subprocess,sys,unittest
          root=pathlib.Path.cwd();baseline=root/'.chronology-baseline'
          assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=baseline,text=True).strip()=='9cc74472858ebcb3a80a3a7f12ad67f348304d13'
          sys.path.insert(0,str(baseline))
          from competition import continuous_account_replay_v2 as engine
          assert pathlib.Path(engine.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(baseline.resolve())
          name='research_core_v4.laboratory.test_chronological_contracts'
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,root/'research_core_v4/laboratory/test_chronological_contracts.py')
          module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[name]=module;spec.loader.exec_module(module)
          result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(module))
          assert result.testsRun==12 and len(result.failures)==13 and not result.errors
          print('MXM_CHRONOLOGY_BEFORE: immutable9cc7447;12 methods;13 expected assertion failures;0 errors;artificial inputs only')
          PY
      - name: Reproduce resource, partition and semantic defects on immutable source
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import importlib.util,pathlib,sys,unittest
          root=pathlib.Path.cwd();baseline=root/'.chronology-baseline'
          sys.path.insert(0,str(baseline))
          suite=unittest.TestSuite()
          for short in ('test_resource_contracts','test_partition_authority','test_semantic_schema'):
              name='research_core_v4.laboratory.'+short
              spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,root/'research_core_v4/laboratory'/(short+'.py'))
              module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[name]=module;spec.loader.exec_module(module)
              if short=='test_semantic_schema':
                  suite.addTests(module.SemanticSchema(k) for k in ('test_numeric_cosmetic_and_universe_equivalence','test_unknown_top_level_field_is_not_a_new_identity'))
              else:suite.addTests(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(module))
          result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          assert result.testsRun==9 and len(result.failures)==15 and not result.errors
          print('MXM_RESOURCE_PARTITION_SEMANTIC_BEFORE: immutable9cc7447;9 methods;15 expected assertion failures;0 errors')
          PY
      - name: Reproduce checkout provenance defects on immutable recovery source
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import importlib.util,pathlib,sys,unittest
          root=pathlib.Path.cwd();baseline=root/'.chronology-baseline'
          sys.path.insert(0,str(baseline))
          name='research_core_v4.laboratory.test_checkout_provenance'
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,root/'research_core_v4/laboratory/test_checkout_provenance.py')
          module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[name]=module;spec.loader.exec_module(module)
          result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(module))
          assert result.testsRun==5 and len(result.failures)==15 and not result.errors
          print('MXM_CHECKOUT_BEFORE: immutable9cc7447;5 methods;15 expected assertion failures;0 errors;artificial native fixtures only')
          PY
      - name: Reproduce mutable-source admission on immutable recovery source
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import importlib.util,pathlib,sys,unittest
          root=pathlib.Path.cwd();baseline=root/'.chronology-baseline'
          sys.path.insert(0,str(baseline))
          name='research_core_v4.laboratory.test_source_freeze'
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,root/'research_core_v4/laboratory/test_source_freeze.py')
          module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[name]=module;spec.loader.exec_module(module)
          result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(module))
          assert result.testsRun==3 and len(result.failures)==10 and not result.errors
          print('MXM_SOURCE_FREEZE_BEFORE: immutable9cc7447;3 methods;10 expected assertion failures;0 errors')
          PY
      - name: All laboratory modules and continuous account regressions
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import pathlib, unittest
          names = sorted(str(p.with_suffix('')).replace('/', '.') for p in pathlib.Path('research_core_v4/laboratory').glob('test_*.py'))
          names.append('tests.test_continuous_account_replay_v2')
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(names))
          raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())
          PY
      - name: Verify real protected OWNER/R2/checkpoint20 evidence via GitHub GET only
        run: python3 -m research_core_v4.laboratory.live_preflight_v3
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Measure native read-token visibility of existing control ACLs
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from research_core_v4.remediation_p0_p4_20261015.rest29_v3 import GetOnly
          route=GetOnly()
          for ident in (25222248,25461184,25461373,25461529):
              policy=route.json('rulesets/'+str(ident))
              print('MXM_NATIVE_ACL_VISIBILITY '+json.dumps({'ruleset':ident,'enforcement':policy['enforcement'],'updated_at':policy['updated_at'],'bypass_field_present':'bypass_actors' in policy,'bypass_actors':policy.get('bypass_actors')}))
          PY
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
